note: Gloss 'a little plotter in the household' is accurate and keeps the joke; no other changes.
'parlour' here denotes the room behind the breakfast-room door; 'into the breakfast room' is faithful and removes the apparent second room.
closet->little bedroom, crib->bed match period senses; consistent with 'bedside' in 5.1; nothing else changed.
Eutychus gloss (Acts 20: slept during Paul's preaching, fell from third loft) is accurate and makes the 'third loft' joke land.
'Yet such eloquence was exactly what marked Helen's speech' answers the rhetorical question faithfully to 'Such was the characteristic of Helen's discourse'.
'its answers' removes the stray 'her'; meaning unchanged.
Word order fixed to 'would at least not recoil'; faithful, nothing else changed.
Restoring archaic 'that you spread' (= so that / is that why) is faithful but still unidiomatic; modern readers will not hear the causal link the flag asked for.
new_text: "For the men in green—the fairies. It was a perfect moonlit evening for them. Did I break through one of your rings? Is that why you spread that damned ice on the road?"

Untangled syntax preserves meaning: both natures made acrid/savourless by lack of generous feeling.

Rewrite changed the source's causal 'for' ('for I lay that pleasant unction to my soul') into additive 'and', losing the link that his claim rests on his belief in her affection.
new_text: "That you may, my good little girl. There is not another being in the world who has the same pure love for me as yourself — for I hold that comforting belief close to my heart, Jane: faith in your affection."
